title: Course Schedule
statement:
You are given a number of courses labeled from 0 to numCourses - 1 and a list of prerequisite pairs. Each pair [a, b] indicates that you must take course b before you can take course a.

Determine if it is possible to finish all courses. Return true if you can finish all courses, and false otherwise.
constraints: All the pairs prerequisites[i] are unique

visibleExamples.explanation: Take course 0 first, then course 1. No cycle exists.
Circular dependency: course 0 requires 1, and course 1 requires 0.
Take course 2 first, then 1, then 0. No cycle exists.

jsonFriendlyReason: All parameters are primitives (int, list[list[int]]) and the return type is bool, which are all JSON-representable.
